description: This file contains utility functions for IPv4 address manipulation, validation, and classification, including functions to convert between dotted quad and integer representations, check address types (e.g., RFC1918, loopback, multicast), and perform bit operations relevant to network calculations.

methods.name: assert_uint32
methods.description: Validates that the input is a decimal integer within the 32-bit unsigned integer range.

methods.name: bitcount
methods.description: Counts the number of bits set to 1 in a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: str2ip
methods.description: Converts a dotted IPv4 address string into a 32-bit integer.

methods.name: ip2str
methods.description: Converts a 32-bit integer into a dotted IPv4 address string.

methods.name: prefix2netmask
methods.description: Converts a prefix length (e.g., 24) to a network mask in 32-bit integer form.

methods.name: is_contiguous
methods.description: Checks if the bitmask has contiguous upper bits.

methods.name: netmask2prefix
methods.description: Converts a netmask to prefix length after validating contiguity.

methods.name: is_rfc1918
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is within RFC1918 private address ranges.

methods.name: is_rfc3927
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is in the link-local range (RFC3927).

methods.name: is_loopback
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a loopback address.

methods.name: is_multicast
methods.description: Checks if an IP address is a multicast address.
